problem_statement: When the DNS service-discovery server is queried for SOA or NS records for its default service-discovery domain (e.g. "default.service.arpa.", or a name under it such as "myhost.default.service.arpa."), or for an ANY record on that domain, the server returns an empty response instead of an SOA record (in the Answer section for the domain itself, or in the Authority section for a name under it) and an NS record. A client performing such a query receives no records where it expects one, so it cannot obtain zone authority information or the server's host name. SOA/NS/ANY queries for the service-discovery domain should be answered with the appropriate records, while a ResolveAddress for the server host name should still resolve to the device's address.
